tasks.title: Create directory `lib/Sections/` if it does not already exist
Create `lib/Sections/AdminSection.php` implementing `OCP\Settings\IIconSection` with constructor injecting `IL10N $l` and `IURLGenerator $urlGenerator`
Implement `getID(): string` — return `'app_versions'`
Implement `getName(): string` — return `$this->l->t('App Versions')`
Implement `getPriority(): int` — return `98`
Implement `getIcon(): string` — return `$this->urlGenerator->imagePath('app_versions', 'app.svg')`
Create directory `lib/Settings/` if it does not already exist
Create `lib/Settings/Admin.php` implementing `OCP\Settings\ISettings` with namespace `OCA\AppVersions\Settings`
Implement `getForm(): TemplateResponse` — return `new TemplateResponse(Application::APP_ID, 'index', [], '')` (empty renderAs string embeds form inside the settings page)
Implement `getSection(): string` — return `'app_versions'`
Implement `getPriority(): int` — return `10`
Remove the entire `<navigations>` block (including its `<navigation>` child) from `appinfo/info.xml`
Add a `<settings>` block declaring `<admin>OCA\AppVersions\Settings\Admin</admin>` and `<admin-section>OCA\AppVersions\Sections\AdminSection</admin-section>`
Delete `lib/Controller/PageController.php` (removes the `#[FrontpageRoute(verb: 'GET', url: '/')]` entry point; the UI is now served only via the admin settings form)
Grep the codebase for references to `PageController`, `page.index`, and the `GET /` route; confirm nothing else depends on them (e.g. `appinfo/info.xml` navigation `<route>` is removed in task 3.1)

Create `tests/unit/Sections/AdminSectionTest.php` — test that `getID()` returns `'app_versions'`, `getPriority()` returns an int, `getName()` returns a non-empty string, `getIcon()` returns a non-empty string
Create `tests/unit/Settings/AdminTest.php` — test that `getSection()` returns `'app_versions'`, `getPriority()` returns an int, `getForm()` returns a `TemplateResponse` instance
Run `composer cs:check` and fix any coding-style violations in the new files
Run `composer psalm` and resolve any type errors or warnings in the new files
Run `composer test:unit` and confirm all unit tests pass (including the new Section and Settings tests)
Enable the app on a running Nextcloud instance and open **Settings → Administration** — confirm "App Versions" appears in the sidebar with icon
Click **App Versions** in the administration sidebar — confirm the Vue SPA renders correctly inside the settings panel (app list loads, version picker works)
Open the top-level Nextcloud navigation menu — confirm no "App Versions" entry appears
Log in as a non-admin user — confirm the Administration section does not show App Versions and direct API calls return 403 Forbidden
Navigate to `<base_url>/index.php/apps/app_versions/` directly — confirm the old front-page route no longer serves the UI (route removed)
